title: I Tracked the Makerspace Key-Fob Through Three Audits After They Cloned Mine

parts.text: Audit one showed my fob opening the CNC room at 11:42 p.m. when I was on a train. I was twenty-nine, member, holding a transit screenshot. The access policy said: FOBS ARE UNIQUE. CLONES FAIL THE AUDIT. Front-desk lead Nico said the log lagged. I photographed the log, the screenshot, and my fob serial. Then a second ping I did not make hit the laser at 11:51. I let them finish the sentence they would regret in writing. Petty is a word people use when their name is on the ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: A second ping I did not make just hit the laser at 11:51.

social.video_title: The audit showed my fob while I was on a train — Part 1/3
social.description: CNC at 11:42, a transit still, a laser ping next. Would you have photographed the serial?

parts.text: Audit two I followed with the stills. The laser took the same serial. Nico palmed a spare that was not a unique fob I could see from the desk cam. I was still twenty-nine, still the file. I added the cam still to the audit chat and asked for clone detection. Detection flagged Nico's spare. I forwarded the flag to the board and put a hold on audit three's after-hours. I added the second still before anyone could call it a vibe. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: After-hours are on hold and audit three is already at the board.

social.video_title: Clone detection flagged the desk spare — Part 2/3
social.description: Spare fob, a cam still, held after-hours. The board has the flag. Does lag still feel like 11:42?

parts.text: Audit three ran on a rider: SPARES ARE INVENTORIED. Clones came off. They recoded CNC, laser, and after-hours. I keep a fob that opens my hours. Optics is a word desks use when a train exists. The serial survived three audits. The shop at 11:42 sounds like a shop, which is to say empty and nobody's spare. I kept the printout in a folder labeled BORING. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.

social.description: Recoded rooms, a rider, clones off. Was lag ever a spare?
